name: fda_audit_trail
description: 21 CFR Part 11 audit-trail reference: chained entries, e-signature manifestation, and signed export package from the fda-package example.

crypto.hash: SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4, standard test vectors in tpt-med-audit)

metrics.name: retroactive_edit_detection
metrics.assert: modifying any entry reason invalidates verification

metrics.name: seed_splice_detection
metrics.assert: different run_id yields a different chain

metrics.name: signature_manifestation
metrics.assert: exported JSON carries signer, timestamp, and meaning (reviewer)

metrics.name: tag_binding
metrics.assert: any payload change changes the detached HMAC tag

expected.reference_artifact: test-data/golden/regulatory/fda_export_example.json (regenerated by cargo run -p tpt-med-examples --bin fda-package; timestamps/digests differ per run by design)

notes: The HMAC tag provides record-set integrity and attribution, not non-repudiation; external trust anchoring is reserved in the package format (rfcs/0003).
